tools.name: get_image_sizes
tools.description: The recommended image sizes in pixels for a social or shop platform, print or the web: posts, stories, covers, thumbnails, banners, profile photos and more. Leave platform empty to list every platform. Each size comes with a link that opens the Six-IR resizer set to that size.

tools.name: make_resize_link
tools.description: A link that opens the free Six-IR resizer with a platform size picked and/or a maximum file size in KB set, so the person only has to add their photo.
